# Prompt templates

Hand-written prompts for AI assistants — paste them into Copilot,
ChatGPT, Claude, or wherever you do your AI work. The `Prompts/` folder
in the repo holds the originals; below is a quick catalog.

| File | What it instructs the AI to do |
|---|---|
| [`GitHub-Copilot-Chat-Custom-Personal-Instructions.txt`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/blob/main/Prompts/GitHub-Copilot-Chat-Custom-Personal-Instructions.txt) | Act as a senior software engineer: focus on architecture, best practices, clean code (Java/SQL/MVC), scalability, clarity. |
| [`GitHub-PR.txt`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/blob/main/Prompts/GitHub-PR.txt) | Generate well-structured PR descriptions with overview, key changes, commit highlights, impact analysis, testing notes. |
| [`general-search.txt`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/blob/main/Prompts/general-search.txt) | Provide concise initial answers, then point at deeper concepts. Speed-first reading order. |
| [`rephrasing-parameters.txt`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/blob/main/Prompts/rephrasing-parameters.txt) | Accept parameters (tone, complexity, style, length, audience, structure) to rephrase content variably. |
| [`short-notes.txt`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/blob/main/Prompts/short-notes.txt) | Create minimalistic, context-focused notes; concise terminology, human-like language. |
| [`story-fusion-wizard.txt`](https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts/blob/main/Prompts/story-fusion-wizard.txt) | Fuse multiple narrative drafts into one ultra-engaging story with cultural flair and cinematic detail. |

## Usage

These are plain text files. Open, copy, paste into your AI tool's
"custom instructions" or system-prompt field.
